top_signal.title: Software to track sample loans (stain samples, cabinet doors) like a library checkout system?
top_signal.summary: I’m looking for a better way to track my inventory since Excel isn't cutting it for my loaner samples.    I’m opening a studio soon and want to use barcodes or QR codes on all samples to keep track of who has what and when they checked it out. Currently, I have three designers and one homeowner who has doors and or stains samples.   I need the program to allow me to put nane and date, maybe their contact info too, but I do have it elsewhere. I don't want an app the reason a barcode or qr code that goes to an excel sheet either. I need a program that can spit me out reminders, if possible.    Tiger Asset looms close to what I need, but it is $20/ month for 500 assets and $40/mo for 2500. I will probably have just over 500 samples.   Do you have any software recommendations for that?       submitted by     /u/Prestigious-Cap212       [link]       [comments]
